scripts.slides: npm run build-dir && marp --theme-set theme --html -w -p -o build/preview.html slides.md
scripts.slides:watch: npm run build-dir && marp --theme-set theme --html -w -o build/preview.html slides.md
scripts.slides:pdf: npm run build-dir && marp --theme-set theme --pdf --allow-local-files -o build/agentic-runtime-summit.pdf slides.md
scripts.slides:html: npm run build-dir && marp --theme-set theme --html --allow-local-files -o build/agentic-runtime-summit.html slides.md
